title: Novo Nordisk opens Czech plant and unveils $29M upgrade to China facility

title: Asimov Announces Strategic Partnership with the Rosalind & Morris Goodman Cancer Institute at McGill University to Advance Next-Generation Biologics
llm_note: Asimov is providing cell line and process development technologies to the Goodman Cancer Institute.

title: Continuous Production Platform Offers New Gene Therapy Options

title: Bacterial Expression Tech Prompts NorthX and enGenes Collaboration
